content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Classification: deviation (critical, IP — ownership of deliverables and Customer Data).**

Key points found across the document:
- **§ 8(d) (p0054)** — Client grants TrueLink a worldwide licence to "distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit" Credit Data (borrower/loan applicant data of Client, its affiliates, customers and brokers). That is an independent exploitation right over our data, well beyond processing to provide the Hosting/Support Services, and the only limiter is a cross-referenced Non-Competition Agreement.
- **§ 2(d) (p0029)** — the sole ownership clause runs TrueLink's way (Interface retained). Acceptable, and relied on as already-met for "Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property".
- **§ 10(b)–(c) (p0063, p0065)** — "all results of the Hosting and Support Services" are only *confidential* Client Proprietary Information; no ownership, assignment or licence-back of the customisation/programming work product we pay for under § 4.
- No Customer Data ownership statement and no bar on joint ownership anywhere.

Cure (preferred level, two operations): a new § 2(e) giving Client ownership of deliverables/work product with TrueLink's assignment, a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to embedded TrueLink IP, retained Client rights in Client Content, Credit Data and all other Client-supplied data, and no joint ownership; plus a surgical narrowing of § 8(d) to use, upload, copy and store Credit Data "solely to provide the Hosting Services and Support Services", keeping the remaining wording verbatim.
